schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT P2.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT P2 INNER JOIN SALES S2 ON P2.PRODUCT_ID = S2.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE < '2018-12-31' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-04-01')
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT P2.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT P2 INNER JOIN SALES S2 ON P2.PRODUCT_ID = S2.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE < '2018-12-31' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-04-01')
counterexample: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (1, 'Product A', 100); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 101, 201, '2019-04-01', 1, 100);
explanation: Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred strictly between 2019-01-01 and 2019-03-31 (inclusive). Q2 selects products whose no sale occurred before 2018-12-31 or after 2019-04-01. These are logically different: Q1 requires all sales to be within the range, while Q2 excludes any product with a single sale outside that range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with a single sale on 2019-04-01 would be excluded by Q2 but included by Q1. Another product with a sale on 2019-04-01 and another on 2019-01-01 would be included by Q1 but excluded by Q2.
